title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management
summary: Information Security Management System (ISMS) requirements (Clauses 4–10) and the 93 Annex A controls across Organizational, People, Physical, and Technological themes.

domains.title: ISMS Requirements (Clauses 4–10)
domains.description: Context of the organization, leadership, risk assessment & treatment, Statement of Applicability (SoA), internal audit, management review, and continual improvement.

domains.title: A.5 Organizational Controls
domains.description: 37 controls covering information security policies, threat intelligence, cloud services security, supplier relationships, incident management, and compliance.

domains.title: A.6 People Controls
domains.description: 8 controls covering screening, terms of employment, security awareness & training, disciplinary process, remote working, and NDA/confidentiality agreements.

domains.title: A.7 Physical Controls
domains.description: 14 controls covering physical perimeters, entry controls, securing offices/facilities, physical security monitoring, clear desk/clear screen, and equipment disposal.

domains.title: A.8 Technological Controls
domains.description: 34 controls covering endpoint devices, privileged access, cryptography, vulnerability management, configuration management, data masking, DLP, and secure coding.
